<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A limit of requests a minute per client, answered with rate_limited (429) and Retry-After past it. It counts in memory: it holds for one instance of the service.

```esquadro
blueprint rate_limit
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [i18n](../i18n/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `per_minute` | int | `120` | Requests a minute each client may make; 0 turns the limit off. &lt;APP>_RATE_LIMIT overrides it. |

```esquadro
blueprint rate_limit {
  per_minute 120
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<APP>_RATE_LIMIT` | int | the per_minute option | Requests a minute each client may make; 0 is no limit. |
